Privacy

Simple reading. Clear privacy.

Fieldnotes has no accounts, comments, analytics, tracking cookies, or visitor database. It presents sample essays and a search form for exploring the collection.

Current behaviour

The server receives normal web request information needed to return a page. Search text and topic selections appear in the page URL and may be retained in browser history or hosting request logs. Avoid entering personal or sensitive information. This application does not maintain a visitor database. In the static website, filtering runs in your browser.

Future features

If accounts, comments, analytics, or other data-processing features are added, this page should be updated before those features are published.
